text:
Priya (PM): quick async check — Q2 milestone 'Smart Routing v2'. what actually shipped last week, what slipped, and immediate blockers? pinging owners @alex @maria @darren. TL;DR: need CR clearance for canary + infra flake fix

Alex (Eng): shipped -> continuous-batcher perf win (PR #4321). canary blocked on CR from @maria. no infra blockers from my side.

Maria (Eng): looked at PR, left a couple comments around kv-cache invalidation. it's a small refactor though. i can do CR by EOD if alex addresses comments.

Darren (Infra): autoscaler tweak is currently slipped. staging shows a flake (nil pointer in resource monitor). i'll dig in tonight, hoping to have a fix by tomorrow. if fixed, we can enable burst capacity for dedicated pools.

Priya (PM): noted. status: shipped = batcher perf; slipped = autoscaler tweak (owner @darren). next steps: @maria CR, @alex address comments, @darren fix staging flake. aim for canary by Thu (soft target).

Alex (Eng): working on comments now. quick q: what's the canary ratio we agreed on? last doc said 5% for latency-critical routes.

Maria (Eng): yes 5%. also suggest adding a safety cutoff in rollout policy: if p95 increases >20% -> auto-rollback.

Sam (QA): i can add smoke tests for the kv invalidation case and load spike. will use an env toggle so it doesn't run in all CI. any objections?

Lina (SRE): i'll watch the canary and add a dedicated alert channel. please add me to the PR for tracing hooks so i can attach tracing dashboards.

Priya (PM): action items written: alex -> update PR; maria -> CR + unit test; darren -> staging fix; sam -> smoke tests with toggle; lina -> monitoring hooks. i'll update milestone doc and send a Thu 10am PT async follow-up invite. :calendar:

Alex (Eng): PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 — main comment in `kv_cache.go` around lines ~140-160. snippet:
```
if err == ErrStaleKV { // need to refetch
  // TODO: backoff and refresh
}
```

Maria (Eng): got it. i'll post a suggested patch and add a small unit test for the invalidation path.

Darren (Infra): example failing log from staging: `resource_monitor.go:87] unexpected nil pointer` — pushing branch `autoscaler/fix-nil-87` in a bit.

Sam (QA): i'll wire smoke test into nightly CI with toggle `SMOKE_KV_INVALIDATION=true` and run until we get a clean pass.

Priya (PM): thanks all. i'll close this thread after i update the milestone doc. if anything slips earlier, DM me. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary kickoff recorded at 2024-06-19T18:20:00Z for route `latency-critical/*` (ratio=5%).
